sections.indications_and_usage: Uses : To help reduce bacteria that potentially can cause disease.
sections.dosage_and_administration: Directions : Single use wipes for hands. Close properly after dispensing to maintain purity, as alcohol by its nature evaporates quickly. Dispose of properly. DO NOT FLUSH. Apply thoroughly to hands to cover all surfaces. Rub hands together until dry.
sections.warnings_and_cautions: Warnings : For external use only: hands, general cleansing. Does not replace wipes used for medical procedures. Flammable; keep away from fire or flame. Do not ingest.
